title: Volume Pricing of Instant Payouts for Top Rated and Preferred Partner Sellers, Northloop Payments
content:
Northloop Payments prices instant payouts by payout volume for sellers at the two highest levels of Seller Performance Standing.

**Rule.** The volume-priced instant fee rate is the plan's instant payout fee rate less 0.0050 when the seller's instant pricing volume is at least 500000 USD (500,000 USD) and the seller's current performance standing level is Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level; it is the plan's rate less 0.0025 when the instant pricing volume is at least 250000 USD (250,000 USD) but below 500000 USD and the level is Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level; otherwise it is the plan's instant payout fee rate. The instant fee rate of an instant payout is worked from the volume-priced instant fee rate.

The instant pricing volume is a measure of the sale credits booked on the seller's Northloop Payments account; the level is the seller's current level on the Seller Performance Standing record.

## Ladder

| Current Seller Performance Standing level | Instant pricing volume | Volume-priced instant fee rate |
|---|---|---|
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | at least 500000 USD | the plan's instant payout fee rate less 0.0050 |
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | at least 250000 USD but below 500000 USD | the plan's instant payout fee rate less 0.0025 |
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | below 250000 USD | the plan's instant payout fee rate |
| any other level | any volume | the plan's instant payout fee rate |

## Hypothetical readings (plan rate 0.015)

- Preferred Partner Level, instant pricing volume 500000.00 USD: at the upper threshold, so the rate is 0.015 less 0.0050, that is 0.0100.
- Top Rated Level, volume 499999.99 USD: the middle tier, 0.015 less 0.0025, that is 0.0125.
- Above Standard Level, volume 900000.00 USD: not one of the two levels, so the rate stays 0.015.
